address: 171 Chan Road, Wat Phraya Krai, Bang Kho Laem, Bangkok, 10120, Thailand
bio: Tang Jai Yang’s chef started cooking char siu, or Cantonese-style barbecue pork, for family and friends before selling it online. There, it went viral, so he opened this understated place. Since almost every dish on the menu contains the succulent pork, you can’t really go wrong....
